title: Te Kai Tūpono a te Kaumātua
intro: I roto i ngā wāhi tapu o te Whare o Allah, i pāngia tētahi pononga kaumātua o te Atua e tētahi mea ngaro hohonu i tino kitea. I kite tēnei tangata pono, kua roa kē atu i ngā tau o te mātua tūturu, i tētahi mea whakamiharo i whakaatu i te aroha mutunga kore o te Atua. Ko te panga kei roto i te hura i tēnei wā kua warewarehia i roto i te oranga o ngā poropiti.
clues: I mōhiotia tōku iwi ko Iharaira, he uri nō tētahi patereareha nui o mua.
I whakapaua e ahau ōku pō ki te inoi, ki te piko ki te aroaro o tōku Ariki i roto i te temepara.
I tukua mai he tama ki ahau i tōku koroheketanga, he taonga kāore i mutu taku whakakororia i a Allah mōna.
Ko tāku whakamātautau i uru atu ai te kitenga i tētahi oranga mō tētahi wairua taitamariki i raro i taku manaaki.
He poropiti ahau, ko Zakariyya tōna ingoa, i tukuna ki ahau te mahi tiaki i a Maryam i Bayt al-Maqdis.
Kei roto i te whiti i whakaae a Allah ki a Meriama, ā, i whakarato hoki i te oranga mōna.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ko te poropiti i tiaki i a Meriama i te temepara
Ko te poropiti nāna i hanga te whare tapu
I horomia te poropiti e te ika nui
Ko te poropiti i rere atu i tōna iwi
Ko te poropiti i kōrero tika ki a Allah
identity.answer: Ko te poropiti i tiaki i a Meriama i te temepara

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: E whakamatautauria ana e ngā tau o te tauraki
Te kimi i te oranga i whakaratohia mō tētahi wāhanga taitamariki i roto i te mea ngaro
Te kauwhau ki tētahi iwi i whakakahore i te aratohu a te Atua
Te makanga ki roto i te poka e te iwi ake
Te whiwhi whakakitenga mā roto i ngā kitenga
trial.answer: Te kimi i te oranga i whakaratohia mō tētahi wāhanga taitamariki i roto i te mea ngaro

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He kaipuke i hangaia mai i ngā papa me ngā whao
Te temepara tapu o Hiruharama
He māra i whakangaromia
He tāone i hanga e te kingi tika
Ngā hōhonutanga o te moana

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakapono te iwi, ā, i aru i te karere
Te manako me te aroha o te Atua mō te hunga e whakatapua ana ki te karakia
I tau te whiu ki te hunga whakakeke
I whānau mai he tama i te koroheketanga e ai ki te kupu whakaari
Te ara haumaru i roto i te koraha
outcome.answer: Te manako me te aroha o te Atua mō te hunga e whakatapua ana ki te karakia

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
